name: Pixel
author: Launcher (from Android 16 on a Pixel, measured on the Android 17 emulator)
_about: Android 16 as a Pixel shows it: Material You colours from the wallpaper (the system's roles, @primary...), the device's sans-serif, one dp per point, and Android's own layouts where they differ (the shade first). Only what differs from iOS 27 is written here. References: tools/shots/pxref, docs/PIXEL_PROFILE.md.
